title: Shregoo optimised
description: A lightweight performance modpack that boosts FPS, reduces lag, and makes Minecraft smoother — crafted and optimized by Shregoo for the best gameplay experience.
body:
Boost your FPS, reduce lag, and make Minecraft run smoother than ever!
Shregoo Optimisation is a lightweight modpack designed to deliver maximum performance with minimal setup. Perfect for PvP, survival, or creative play — experience lightning-fast loading, stable frame rates, and an overall smoother gameplay experience.

⚡ Features:

FPS Boost & lag reduction

Faster chunk loading

Smooth animations & optimized graphics

Low system resource usage

Compatible with most servers and mods

💻 Ideal for: Low-end PCs and players who want the best performance without losing the vanilla feel.
